model_annotation: The pie chart is titled "V4. In which stage is system integration better integrated in the product development process in our organization?" It is a visual representation of the level of integration of design in the product development process across different stages within the organization. The chart is divided into five sectors, each representing a different level of system integration. The smallest sector, colored in red, represents "Not integrated at all," while the largest sector, colored in orange, represents "Good," with a value of 24. The second largest sector, colored in green, represents "Well integrated," with a value of 25. The third largest sector, colored in red, represents "Mostly integrated," with a value of 10. The fourth sector, colored in blue, represents "Poorly integrated," with a value of 2. The pie chart includes a legend with corresponding colors to the sectors, and the sectors are spread out without any specific order based on size. The chart does not include a legend with percentages or any other explanatory text that indicates what each percentage or value represents.
